Extract average treatment effect estimates and confidence intervals

Source: R/atefit-extract.R
atefit-extract.Rd

Extract treatment effects from an atefit object on their native estimation scale: the log rate ratio for count outcomes, or the log RMTL ratio, conditional log hazard ratio, and log cumulative hazard ratio for survival outcomes. Exponentiate the returned estimates and interval limits to obtain ratios.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'atefit'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'atefit'
confint(object, parm, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class atefit.

...

Additional arguments; currently unused.

parm

A character vector of effect names or a numeric vector of effect positions. If omitted, all treatment effects are included.

level

Confidence level, a single number strictly between 0 and 1. Default is 0.95.

Value

coef() returns a named numeric vector of treatment effect estimates. confint() returns a matrix with one row per selected treatment effect and columns for the lower and upper confidence limits.

Details

Confidence intervals are normal (Wald) intervals calculated using the bootstrap standard errors stored in the fitted object. Changing level does not repeat the bootstrap. Treatment-specific event rates and restricted mean survival times are not included.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fit <- atefitcount(data = countExample,
  cate.model = y ~ age + offset(log(years)), ps.model = trt ~ age)
exp(coef(fit))
exp(confint(fit))
exp(confint(fit, level = 0.90))
} # }
